bullets.text: emptied a folder called misc. it had been misc since 2019 and had honestly earned the name.
ninth day at okunoin. duck carries a line about living simply. the moss on the lantern has been at it for years. 🌾
overcast since dawn, the same grey the whole time. the sky is running one frame on a loop.
twenty-three degrees. ninth day of rest and the legs have begun making suggestions.
opened the fridge with no plan. closed it. opened it again to see whether a plan had arrived.
